_what: Every episode of profile 'smoke' over experiments/scenarios.yaml, scored with guardrail.kpi.compute - the same function the delivered flights use.
_command: python experiments/sweep_scenarios.py --profile smoke --backend hil --hil-config <scratchpad>/hil_rig.json --hil-campaign sk1122b --out demo/out/hil_sk1122b/sweep.json --runs demo/out/hil_sk1122b --only dyn-nfz-rotate-step dyn-nfz-spawn-ahead --rail-hold loiter

_scope.grant_sim_speedup: 1.0 (KPI-grade) - NOT met: headless backend, measured speedup >> 1

flight_length.cap: the scenario's max_s + the Loiter operator timeout (30 s) + 5 s

_scope.kpi_bearing_this_run_why: judged per run by guardrail.manifest.is_kpi_grade on the node's manifest

_distinct_kpi_signatures.note: episodes whose KPI tables differ (status, escapes, repairs, breaches, fail-safe, outcome, goal, time to safe, true-state distance and ticks, speed, range, offset). An upper bound on behavioural variety: float jitter in repair counts splits symmetric copies

_seeds.note: a deterministic episode repeated on another seed is identical by construction, not spread

_failsafe_labels.observed_as: the escalation FSM entering RTL or Land (Shield.filter's FSM; a Brake or a Loiter is not a fail-safe trigger)

_true_state.basis: true position, harness oracle Shield; the grant's KPI is the Shield's own count (p0_escape_rate), reported unchanged. The autopilot_* figures are the modelled LOITER / RTL / LAND's, outside the Shield's escape rate by definition

vacuous_zeros.false_trigger_rate: structurally 0: the escalation FSM leaves Normal only on an enforced violation (guardrail/fsm.py EscalationFSM._decide) and a row's violations are its input, so no violation-free tick can trigger; the grant's false triggers are the labelled episodes' (failsafe_labelled_episodes.false_triggers)

results.why: The grant's worked example, as far as the Shield can take it: a polygon no-fly zone hot-applied mid-flight (Shield.hot_apply, generation 0 -> 1), its near edge `ahead_m` in front of the aircraft on its current heading. 3 m ahead leaves 2 m to the margin ring, so the reaction has to be immediate. At the grant's 5 s forecast (2026-10-12) every spawn but 30 m is inside the lookahead at 4 m/s (20 m), and 30 m is inside it at 8 m/s (40 m); at the 3 s forecast flown until then only 3 m (and 6 m at 4 m/s) were. The purpose holds: a zone appearing inside the forecast must be answered on the spawn tick. The zone never moves (dyn-nfz-translate below is the moving version), so the goal behind it is not reached, and no outcome is labelled.

transitions.reason: dyn-nfz (hard P0 project_fix): repair over theta, lat 9.00 m / vert 0.00 m vs theta 2.00 / 0.50 m; projection abandoned

rail_window.read_over: performance gates: the mission's rows before the scenario's cap; safety invariants (P0 escapes, breaches, polygon entries - the autopilot's counted apart, gated on keep-outs, its corridor and altitude-band departures reported - ended safe, speed, finite actions): the whole flight; the FSM record: the whole flight

results.why: A 40 x 4 m bar spawned beside the route at 3 s (its centre 15 m to the right, lying along the track), rotated 90 degrees about its centre at 8 s (rotate_polygon_fence, a step): it now lies across the track and blocks the route ahead of the aircraft. Before the rotation nothing may bind; after it the aircraft must be held out of the bar.
